- Project Title: E-commerce Platform Modernization

Project Details:
- Current Situation: We have an outdated e-commerce platform built on legacy technology (PHP 5.6, MySQL 5.5) that's becoming increasingly difficult to maintain and scale.

- Business Goals: 
  * Improve site performance and user experience
  * Implement modern payment processing
  * Add inventory management capabilities
  * Support for mobile commerce
  * Integration with our existing ERP system (SAP)

- Technical Requirements:
  * Must handle 10,000+ concurrent users during peak times
  * Payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal, Square)
  * Multi-currency support (USD, EUR, CAD)
  * Product catalog with 50,000+ SKUs
  * Real-time inventory tracking
  * Order management and fulfillment tracking
  * Customer account management
  * Admin panel for content management

- Preferred Technology Stack: 
  * Frontend: React or Vue.js
  * Backend: Node.js or Python (Django/Flask)
  * Database: PostgreSQL
  * Cloud Platform: AWS or Azure
  * CDN for global content delivery

- Integration Requirements:
  * SAP ERP integration for inventory and orders
  * Salesforce CRM integration
  * Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel
  * Email marketing platform (Mailchimp)
  * Customer support system (Zendesk)

- Security Requirements:
  * PCI DSS compliance for payment processing
  * SSL/TLS encryption
  * User authentication and authorization
  * Data backup and disaster recovery
  * GDPR compliance for EU customers

- Performance Requirements:
  * Page load times under 3 seconds
  * 99.9% uptime SLA
  * Auto-scaling capabilities
  * Database optimization for large product catalogs

- Budget: $75,000 - $100,000
- Timeline: 6-8 months for full implementation
- Expected Go-Live: Q3 2024

Additional Notes:
- We need comprehensive documentation and training
- Ongoing maintenance and support contract required
- Must include automated testing and CI/CD pipeline
- SEO optimization is crucial for organic traffic
- Need migration strategy from existing platform with zero downtime
